title: HTML report 6-month model drift across traffic slices
what: android_app F1 fell -9.4 pp from May to October (to 77.4%), while web/iOS stayed flat within 95% CI

reader_questions.question: Which slice suffered F1 drift and how many points did it drop from May to October?
reader_questions.expected: android_app dropped 9.4 percentage points (from 86.8% down to 77.4%).

reader_questions.question: How is evaluation uncertainty shown?
reader_questions.expected: 95% confidence bands across n = 2,000 samples per slice-month.

reader_questions.question: How did the other three slices behave?
reader_questions.expected: us_web, eu_web, and ios_app stayed flat within ~1 point.
